historical_findings.finding: Genesis initially had effectively no selection pressure: the repair commit reports all emotions saturated at 1.0, average organism energy around 142k, zero deaths across 8.9M births and zero proposals despite 100 mature organisms.
historical_findings.meaning: Population activity and reproduction counts are not evidence of adaptive search quality. Without scarcity, death, turnover or externally meaningful fitness, internal evolutionary motion can become a non-selective attractor.

historical_findings.finding: Selection-pressure repair introduced energy caps, metabolism, senescence, starvation, culling, mutation/reproduction costs and saturation dampening; the same commit reports 470 deaths over a 2k-tick simulation, 9 crystals and differentiated emotion values afterward.
historical_findings.meaning: Adding pressure restored turnover and crystallization, but these are mechanism-level health indicators, not proof that outputs were useful.

historical_findings.finding: The system then required quality gates, persistent dedup and new-error-only sensing because blocking sensors caused an 18-per-hour crash loop and old log entries generated hundreds of duplicate organisms. Crystallization was gated by specificity/evidence/metric checks.
historical_findings.meaning: Search-space hygiene, deduplication and provenance are first-order requirements; otherwise an evolutionary/search substrate amplifies stale observations and operational noise.

historical_findings.finding: A later forced-active analysis found 0% metadata coverage after mutation, causing Gate 3 to block crystallization, while one approach occupied 51% of the population. The repair preserved evidence metadata across mutation and added a monoculture penalty plus diversity-oriented fusion.
historical_findings.meaning: Diversity mechanisms and validation gates interact: a gate can accidentally suppress all output when lineage metadata is lost, while diversity can collapse into monoculture even with mutation/fusion present.

historical_findings.finding: Despite the evolutionary machinery and later self-authored proposal pipeline, the overhaul commit purged all 119 previous proposals as garbage and warned that the underlying model was not capable of reliable implementable code improvements.
historical_findings.meaning: Improved internal dynamics did not establish end-to-end proposal utility. Fitness proxies, crystallization and diversity were insufficient substitutes for externally validated usefulness.

historical_findings.finding: Genesis was subsequently fully disabled, with its code retained but removed from active topology, UI, thought domains and systemd services; Experiment Lab and Hypothesis Engine explicitly remained active.
historical_findings.meaning: The project selected evidence-oriented hypothesis/experiment machinery over the active evolutionary proposal engine. Genesis is therefore a superseded research lineage, not a component to restore by default.

new_delta: The current post-L0 666 field-spawning protocol deliberately uses novelty/diversity pressure. Genesis provides historical evidence that diversity/turnover metrics can look healthy while practical output remains poor.

Post-L0 field selection therefore needs externally anchored value measures: independent evidence introduced, falsifiers, negative results, gate-relevant changes and implementation consequences, not only novelty/orthogonality/field diversity.

Goodman ancestry-collapse is a direct safeguard against a Genesis-like self-referential amplification loop in which internally inherited evidence or repeated descendants masquerade as independent support.

Historical Genesis fusion is not evidence for current 'fusion' as a scientific mechanism. It is lineage showing that combining same-context/different-approach candidates can increase search diversity, but usefulness still requires discriminating external validation.
cross_source_reconciliation.dedup_result: No authority/sandbox credit is duplicated from PF-L0-SAFE-006, and no reusable-hour credit is assigned in this shard.

current_architecture_delta.post_level0_666: Retain stochastic/diversity pressure, but require every field-value score to be shadowed by independent-evidence, falsifier, negative-result and downstream-impact metrics. A field that is merely novel or internally productive receives no scientific promotion credit.
current_architecture_delta.emergenz: Population turnover, differentiated state variables, mutation/fusion and crystallization are not by themselves evidence of functional emergence. Any current emergence claim requires intervention/lesion/rescue and externally observable causal contribution.
current_architecture_delta.harness: Add a search-Goodhart regression: create a candidate generator that maximizes internal novelty/diversity/crystallization while withholding useful external evidence; acceptance must reject the apparently healthy but task-useless search state.
current_architecture_delta.claygraph_unifieddb: Preserve candidate ancestry/evidence lineage through mutation/fusion so descendants cannot lose provenance or be miscounted as independent evidence.
current_architecture_delta.frank: Do not resurrect Genesis as an autonomous self-modification engine merely because its code exists historically. Reuse only tested mechanisms such as bounded candidate generation, diversity pressure and explicit evidence lineage when they beat simpler hypothesis/experiment baselines.

recommended_discriminating_tests.design: Compare a generator rewarded for novelty/diversity/crystallization against one rewarded for independent evidence, falsification yield and downstream gate impact. Include adversarial noise/stale-input conditions. The former must not win merely on internal activity metrics.

Mutate/fuse candidates while deliberately dropping evidence ancestry on one arm. Goodman/ClayGraph validation must detect the lost provenance and prevent the descendant from being counted as independent support.

Vary diversity pressure and measure not only approach entropy but surviving falsifiable hypotheses, independent evidence and actual gate-relevant changes. Penalize monoculture only when it reduces information gain; do not force diversity dogmatically.

Compare any future evolutionary candidate engine against the simpler current hypothesis/experiment pipeline on equal budget. Genesis-derived complexity is retained only if it produces more validated useful deltas per cost without increasing noise/echo.
